verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs show version/deploy tracking that lets teams see which release version is throwing errors (rollbar-docs-6, rollbar-docs-7), which loosely supports comparing releases, but there is no evidence of the specific 'crash-free sessions/users' or release adoption metrics, nor any canary-vs-stable comparison workflow that release-health tools typically offer. missing for 10: crash-free session/user rate dashboards, release adoption percentages, explicit canary vs stable comparison view.
